pairs.difference: A (the cooler, which also appears among the real anchor cards): a red hero with neutral white lid and ice set against a cool blue sky and sea. That is a warm hero on a cool backdrop, and the whites stay neutral. B: the pool rings are flat full-strength magenta, yellow and blue, the grass is a loud lime and the fence is orange-brown. Every mass is equally loud and there is no neutral area to rest the eye.
pairs.fix: Make the pool rings softer pinks, yellows and blues with lighter, paler highlights. Make the grass a calmer, slightly blue-green and the fence a muted grey-brown, so the pool is the only bright thing on the card.

pairs.difference: A: a cream envelope and a red wax seal on orange wood. The whole card is one warm family (warm_share 1.0, about 2 hue families). The envelope white has drifted to cream, as on the generated computer and lighthouse lessons. B: a teal book on orange wood is a cool hero against a warm backdrop. The sticker accents add variety, and the pale pink page edge stays neutral.
pairs.fix: Make the envelope a cool off-white paper with pale blue-grey shading, not cream. Make the table a less orange, browner wood so the red seal is the only strong warm color.

pairs.difference: A: a pastel yellow canopy with a pink frill and a saturated brown handle. The underside shading stays sweet and pinkish rather than shifting cooler. B: red, orange and yellow panels against cyan, with a cool lavender-grey pole that gives a neutral rest. Both are warm heroes on cool backdrops, so the difference is small.
pairs.fix: Shade the underside of the canopy with a cooler, darker tone. Make the handle a duller grey-brown wood.

pairs.difference: A: the white lace gloves are nearly colorless (subject chroma 0.042). Their shadows take on a pink-lavender cast from a hot-pink background, which is louder than any real card (0.23). The hero almost disappears into a single pink color family. B: a purple fan on a yellow backdrop is a clean complementary pair, like the real flippers card, and the wooden ribs give a muted rest.
pairs.fix: Make the background a calmer, less intense color, such as a soft teal or blue, and keep the gloves clean white with cool grey shading. Make the blue bows a slightly stronger blue so the hero carries the color.

pairs.difference: A: a crimson velvet chair with deep red shadows on a cyan wall and an orange floor, a classic warm hero on a cool backdrop. B: a yellow-orange wooden rocker with a lime cushion on a blue wall. The floor repeats the hero's wood hue, but the real barrel card does the same. All the measurements fall inside the real range for both cards.

B: the top hat is an almost colorless black-maroon with a single red band (subject chroma 0.042). Its shadows lose all color (shadow chroma 0.28, well below the real minimum of about 0.74), so the hero reads as a dead dark hole against the cyan rays. A: a tan jacket, orange cuffs and gold badges, a warm hero on a green field, with colored shadows kept.
pairs.fix: Make the hat a deep blue-black or plum-black with visible cool blue highlights and a richer colored shine on the brim. Make the band a warmer red with a lighter highlight.

pairs.difference: A: a cream feather on a yellow-orange striped wall over an orange table. The hero's white has become cream and sits in the same hue as the backdrop, and the card is almost all warm (warm_share 0.91, above the real maximum). Only the green inkwell breaks it. B: the fountain is in neutral grey-beige stone with cyan water, against yellow, so the cool water separates the hero from the backdrop.
pairs.fix: Make the feather a cool white with pale grey-blue shading and the table a muted brown. Give the wall a cooler or contrasting color so the quill does not melt into the yellow.

pairs.difference: A: the wheel is orange-brown against a pale, washed lavender-and-peach sky (background chroma 0.076, below every real card) over a peach floor. The backdrop has no strong color and leans the same warm way as the hero. B: a gold horn and wood box against a deep purple field, a strong complementary pair, with the purple carried into the shadows.
pairs.fix: Make the background a strong, clear blue or teal with saturated rays, and the deck floor a cooler grey-brown wood.

pairs.difference: A: a navy-black lamp on a teal-blue backdrop. The hero is cool on a cool backdrop (warm_share 0.04), and the purple-pink beam adds a fifth and sixth hue family. The shadows on the barrel go flat grey-navy. B: pink-red coral on a green field, a warm hero against a complementary backdrop, with a dark plum rock as the neutral.
pairs.fix: Make the lamp body a warmer color, or put it on a warm orange or yellow backdrop. Keep the beam a single soft color instead of mixed pink and purple.

pairs.difference: B: a gold watch on a lime-green diamond pattern. Yellow-gold and yellow-green are neighbors, so the card is almost one hue family (1.6), and the background is louder than any real card (0.22). The cream dial takes a green cast. A: a red box with a beige lining and a gold coin on cyan rays. The warm hero sits against a cool backdrop, the blue ribbon is the single accent and the lining is neutral.
pairs.fix: Put the gold watch on a cool blue or purple background, kept a little calmer. Keep the dial a neutral white with grey numerals.

pairs.difference: A: cream-yellow bricks, a pink-peach pavement, pink flowers and warm stone steps. The whole card is pulled warm (warm_share 0.82, above the real maximum), and the whites have gone cream, as in the generated lesson cards. The green door is the only cool mass. B: a saturated blue door framed by orange wood and green ivy, a strong cool hero against warm surroundings.
pairs.fix: Make the brick wall and steps a cool light grey stone, and the pavement grey. Keep the pink flowers as the single warm accent around the green door.

pairs.difference: B: the white teacup and saucer have taken on the purple of the backdrop. Its shading is lavender throughout, and the only other hue is the orange tea, so the card reads as nearly one purple family (1.3 families, subject chroma 0.055). A: a blue machine on purple is also cool-on-cool. However, its colorful cans and bottles and its silver trim break up the palette.
pairs.fix: Shade the cup and saucer in neutral warm grey, not lavender. Change the background to a cool teal or green so the white cup and amber tea stand apart.

pattern: The generated cards drift in three ways. Whites turn cream or take on the background's tint. The hero's hue gets repeated in the backdrop or floor (cream on yellow, gold on lime, a white cup tinted purple), when real cards put a warm hero on a contrasting cool backdrop. And the backdrop is either washed out or louder than any real card, sometimes with shadows that lose their color. The real cards keep cool neutral whites, add one contrasting accent and leave some muted area to rest the eye.
